query:
UPDATE workouts
        SET date = COALESCE($1, date),
            name = CASE WHEN $2 THEN $3 ELSE name END,
            notes = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE notes END,
            body_weight_kg = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7 ELSE body_weight_kg END,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = $8
